title: Beautiful! These are exactly what I wanted!
text: Beautiful! These are exactly what I wanted!. Great colours, good quality and fast arrival. Although I did notice a few small flowers dropping when I got them out of the package but you can easily reattach them back on. They look amazing as decoration and are exactly what I was looking for to decorate! Great product!
